description: Non-boundary catches in attribution_check.py, calibration/physics.py, knowledge/promotion_rules.py, knowledge/stats.py, and knowledge/consult.py still catch broad Exception instead of typed failure classes, inflating the ratchet baseline in test_broad_except_ratchet.py.
goal: Narrow the five non-boundary except Exception handlers in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/attribution_check.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/calibration/physics.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/knowledge/promotion_rules.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/knowledge/stats.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/knowledge/consult.py to specific typed exceptions appropriate to each operation (for example subprocess/OS errors for git log, JSON/OS/value/type/key errors for config loading, value/type/overflow errors for ISO timestamp parsing, and sqlite3.Error/OSError for telemetry writes), tighten MODULE_BROAD_EXCEPT_BASELINES in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_broad_except_ratchet.py by removing those five modules while keeping CI failing when unratcheted except Exception catches are added, and add or update unit tests in the companion test files verifying typed errors are handled while unexpected programming errors propagate. Keep holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json untouched and every touched module within its line budget. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Narrowing non-boundary exception handlers prevents programming errors from being silently swallowed and drives down the repository's broad-except baseline ratchets.
acceptance_criteria: Non-boundary modules (attribution_check.py, calibration/physics.py, knowledge/promotion_rules.py, knowledge/stats.py, knowledge/consult.py) narrow their except Exception catches to typed exceptions and zero except Exception handlers remain in those five modules.

CI fails when unratcheted except Exception catches are added (ratchet-only cap per module/package in test_broad_except_ratchet.py passes when equal or lower, with those five modules removed from MODULE_BROAD_EXCEPT_BASELINES).

Unit tests in test_attribution_check.py, test_calibration_metrics.py, test_knowledge.py, and test_promotion_rules.py verify expected typed exceptions are handled gracefully while unexpected exceptions propagate.
The module budget file holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged and no touched module exceeds its line budget.
uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress", uv run task lint, and uv run task lint-docs pass, and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
